correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normal components a,b≥0, a²+b²=1, orientation budgets R1+R2=W and Bang-box spans Xj(λ). For λ>1, the two-variable inequality is strict if a,b>0; it follows from the concave tangent bound and strict inequality a+b<1+ab for oblique unit normals. The crossing/noncrossing monotonicity argument gives strict Xj<δj and Xk<1 when Rj<δj or Rj=δj with an oblique normal. The strict-slack Bang sign obstruction excludes a cover. Thus W≥min(1,S), all optimizers at S<1 must have axial normals and budgets δj, and a projected interval-length covering argument prohibits overlapping or wasted widths. Boundary h_j in (0,1), finite closed positive-width planks, arbitrary rectangle offset and transition S=1 treated correctly. Independently reran exact rational mixed-normal and axial tests; numerical checks do not prove universality.
